title: Franz Paul von Lisola → Leopold, King of Hungary and Bohemia, Dankow: report with cipher the editor found not deciphered (Pribram no. LX)
correspondents: Franz Paul von Lisola (imperial envoy) → the Emperor / court of Vienna

folio_note: About one and a half pages and two lines of cipher without decipherment, in three places of the report (Pribram p. 284-285). The Karton is assigned from the AIS date ranges; the report is not itemised in the AIS and Pribram gives no folio.
status: Pribram printed the report from the original in the Vienna Staatsarchiv and notes: "Zum Theile nicht dechiffrirt ... Folgt eine halbe Seite nicht dechiffrirt ... why: Lisola's assessment of Charles X Gustav's plans after the Danish declaration of war, days after the Austro-Polish alliance: the unread passages follow his forecast of a Swedish strike through Silesia.
score_note: Scored from the printed edition during the 11 Nov 2026 printed-series sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_printed_series/); original not viewed
verify: Order the leaf from HHStA (Polen I Karton 69; if not there, Brandenburgica or Suecica of the same months). Lisola's other reports of 1655-60 in the same Kartons carry contemporary decipherments (Pribram prints them between asterisks), so the key can be rebuilt from siblings.
